name: lean-project
description: Spend fewer tokens per session: new-project plans with phase gates, lean docs and state files, file maps for reading only the needed lines, model routing for builds, a shared board so parallel agents exchange facts while they run, and a reminder to start a fresh session when the context grows.

context_limit.title: Context limit (tokens)
context_limit.description: Remind me to update the state file and start a new session once the conversation passes this many tokens.

remind_every.title: Remind again every (tokens)
remind_every.description: After the first reminder, remind again each time the conversation grows by this many tokens.

backup_docs.title: Always back up docs before editing
backup_docs.description: On: copy every doc to a dated backup folder before lean-project edits it. Off: back up only when the project is not under version control.

backup_dir.title: Backup folder
backup_dir.description: Where doc backups go, relative to the project folder.
